question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Mu kibiina ky’Olulimi n’Empuliziganya, mu kibiina eky’okuna, omusomesa aleeta ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga “Okuwandiika ebiwandiiko ebiwa amakulu okusobola okubuulira abantu ku nsonga”. Okukola kino, abayizi balonda omutwe ogubasanyusa era banonye, basome, era bawandiike ebikulu ku mutwe ogwo. Omusomesa awa buli muyizi akakodyo akalaga omutwe gw’ensonga okusobola okukungaanya ebirowoozo ebikulu okuva mu biwandiiko bye basomye. Omukodyo ogwogeddwa waggulu gutuukana butya n’ekitundu ki mu kuwandiika?
answer_a: Okukyusaamu
answer_b: Okukyusaamu
answer_c: Okuteekateeka
answer_d: Okuteekateeka ebiwandiiko

question: Ku ndagaano eno wammanga, lwaki ennyonyola engeri omuntu gy’ayigamu olulimi ng’asinziira ku ndowooza y’ebyempeera?
answer_a: Omwana azaalibwa ng’alina engeri y’omunda ey’ebyokwogera, enkola ey’obuntu ey’omuzaaliranwa eyaffe tusigala nayo mu butonde bwaffe, emusobozesa okuyiga n’okwegattako enkola z’empuliziganya n’ennimi.
answer_b: Omwana alina okumanya okukisirikale okw’olulimi lwe okumusobozesa okutegeera n’okufulumya sentensi okusinziira ku ndabika y’enkodde y’olulimi lwe.
answer_c: Omwana atuuka ku lulimi ng’ayita mu kukoppa, obwetaavu bw’okukkusa ebyetaago bye, n’okugumizibwa okuweebwa abazadde be n’ekyokulabirako ky’olulimi ekiri mu mbeera gy’alimu.
answer_d: Omwana alina enkula y’olulimi ekwatagana n’enkula y’obwongo bwe, kale ajja kuyiga okwogera bw’anaatuuka ku mutendera ogumu ogw’enkula y’obwongo.

question: Enjawulo eriwo wakati w'endowooza y'ebyempisa n'endowooza y'ebyembeerabantu ku ngeri okumanya gye kufunibwaamu kwe kutya?
answer_a: Enneeyisa ey’obwongo egamba nti omwana azimba okumanya ng’ayita mu kugezaako n’okukola ensobi, ate enneyisa ey’embeera z’abantu ekola bw’etyo ng’eyita mu kwegattika.
answer_b: Enneeyisa ey’obwongo (Behaviorism) eraga nti endowooza zifunibwa okuyita mu nkyukakyuka mu bwongo, ate mu ssomero ly’ebyembeera n’ennono (sociocultural theory), zifunibwa okuyita mu nkola y’okutereeza.
answer_c: Enneeyisa ey’obukulembeze (Behaviorism) eraga nti okumanya kutuukibwako okuyita mu kukuuma, ate nga omulamwa gwa sociocultural gukozesa nnyo okuyita mu mbeera y’obuntu.
answer_d: Enneeyisa ey’obwongo eraga nti okutegeera ensi kutuukibwako okuyita mu nkola z’obwongo, ate ng’enjigiriza y’embeera z’abantu n’ennono ekkaatiriza okukoppa.

question: Okusinziira ku bigambululo by’ennyingo ya Vygotsky ey’embeera z’abantu n’ennono zaabwe, ki ku bino wammanga ekiraga omulimu omusomesa gw’alina okukola munda mu kibiina?
answer_a: Ateekateeka era alungamya ebintu ebireetera abayizi okukozesa obwongo bwabwe n’okukulaakulanya amagezi ag’ekikugu.
answer_b: Ategekera awamu ebikolebwa mw'akolerera ng'omutabaganya omukulu wakati w'okumanya kw'abayizi n'engeri gye bakuyigamu.
answer_c: Awa abayizi okumanya okutegekeddwa era n’akulaakulanya engeri ze nga yeeyambisa okunyweza n’okulung’amya ebintu.
answer_d: Ategeka emirimu egy'omutindo era egigoberera enteekateeka eteese okusobola okukendeeza ku nkola y'obwongo bw'abayizi n'engeri gye bakyuka.

question:
Soma embeera eno wammanga:
Omusomesa akolera awamu n’omuyizi ow’omu mwaka ogw’omusanvu atandise okukolera awamu n’omuyizi alina obulemu bw’obwongo. Obuzibu obusinga obumutawaanya bwe bwekuusa ku kwijukira ebintu mu bbanga ettono, okussaayo omwoyo okumala akabanga akawerako n’okuteekateeka, ate era obuzibu bulabika mu kusoma n’okuwandiika. Nga twekenneereza engeri y’okukolamu ebintu ennyingi n’enneeyisa y’omuyizi ennyonnyoddwa mu mbeera eno, misinde ki egisinga okuba egy’omugaso okutunuulira nga tukola enteekateeka z’okuyiga?
answer_a: Omutindo n'obwetabuzi
answer_b: Okutabaala n'empisa ennungi ezikyuka okusinziira ku mbeera
answer_c: Obukugu mu birowoozo n'okwenyigira
answer_d: Obukugu mu bwongo n’enneeyisa ennetuukana

question:
Soma embeera eno wammanga:
Martin mwana muwere ow’emyaka omusanvu, omuyizi mu kibiina eky’okubiri era alina obulemu bw’obwongo. Ttiimu y’omu kibiina emukolako, ekkaanya ku nkulaakulana ye mu mwaka gwonna ogw’essomero era bakizuula nti newankubadde enkyukakyuka mu kusomesa n’obuyambi obumuweereddwa, omuyizi takulaakulana nga bwe kyasuubirwa. Lwakuba lweno lwenaaba bagenda okusisinkana famire ye era bateese enteekateeka y’omulimu ogw’awamu wakati w’enjuyi zombi (famire n’essomero). Okusinziira ku kitongole kya American Association on Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (AAIDD), nkola ki ku zino wammanga ekulembedde mu mulimu gwa ttiimu y’omu kibiina kya Martin ne famire ye?
answer_a: Enzirukanya y'ebintu ebiri wabweru w'enkola y'obulamu
answer_b: Omukwanaganyo gw'obutebenkevu
answer_c: Omukwanaganya omukulu
answer_d: Omutendera ogusookerwako (Microsystem)

question:
Soma embeera eno:
Omusomesa mu pulayimale ennyumannyuma amaze wiiki eziwerako ng’akolera ku kiruubirirwa kino: "Okuyiga ku bulamu bw’abakyala n’abasajja abamu, mu biseera ebyayita n’ebya kati, abakoze ebitundu eby’enjawulo mu kitundu kyabwe, eggwanga lyabwe, n’ensi yonna, okuyita mu ngero oba n’obuyambi bw’ebyuma bya ICT." Okukebera ekiruubirirwa kino, omusomesa yatunuulidde empisa zonna ez’abayizi era n’asaba abalabirizi b’abaana okulonda omuntu omu eyakiikirira ebyafaayo bya Chile era bayambe abaana baabwe okuyiga ebikulu basobole oluvannyuma okukola omuzannyo gwa leediyo, buli omu gy’akwata omulimu ogumusobozesa okwogera ku byafaayo by’abantu abaalondeddwa.
Omusomesa atunuulira omulimu guno ng’omukisa okukebera ekiruubirirwa ekikwatagana n’obumu n’obweneggwanga: "Okulaga obusaasizi n’obumu mu mbeera abantu be bafunye oba ezirabiddwa mu biwandiiko oba ebyuma bya ICT, nga bakozesa ebikolwa by’okuwuliriza, obuyambi, n’obukolera wamu."
Nga tutunuulidde omulimu omusomesa gw’ateesezza, kiki ekisinga obulungi okukebera abayizi?
answer_a: Okwebuza ku ŋŋeri y'okukolamu omulimu awamu
answer_b: Okwekebejja ng'omuntu ku lulwo
answer_c: Okwekebeza okukolebwa omuntu omulala
answer_d: Okwekebejja ng'akakiiko ke kakukola.

question:
Soma embeera eno wammanga:
Amalia ali mu kibiina eky’okubiri era afuna obuyambi okuva mu pulogulaamu y’ekibiina ky’abayizi abeenyigira mu byonna, olw’okuba alina obulemu bw’obwongo. Ku ssomero, amanyiddwa ng’omuyimbi, omukozi, era omunoonyezi, naye oluusi ayinza okuba omwesalamu, ekimuleetera okwewaayo eri embeera ez’akabi. Mu somo ly’Ebyafaayo, Geography, n’Ebyobufuzi n’Ensonga z’Ebantu, omusomesa agenda ku kiruubirirwa ky’okuyiga "Okutegeera, okuteesa, okukozesa, n’okunnyonnyola obukulu bw’amateeka agamu ag’obuwaze okwewala embeera ez’akabi ezikwatagana n’obutebenkevu bw’enguudo."
Okusinziira ku mbeera waggulu n’okutunula mu by’obutonde n’omulimu gwabyo, nkola ki mu ngeri zino wammanga etuukirawo okukebereza okutuukiriza ekiruubirirwa ekyogerwako?
answer_a: Tegeka n'abayizi olugendo olw'ebyenjigiriza mu kitundu, abeenyigira mwe bakozesa bye bayize ku bikwaatirizo by'ebidduka.
answer_b: Abayizi mu kibiina bagattibwe mu bubiri bubiri okutegeka ebifo mu bitundu by’essomero eby’enjawulo okumanyisa ku bukulu bw’obubonero bw’ebidduka n’obuzibu obubulimu.
answer_c: Kuba emizannyo n’ebikolwa ebyetaagisa abazannyi okumanya obubonero bw’oku nguudo obw’enjawulo, nga mw’otwalidde embeera ezibaawo mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, nga bikolebwa nga tukozesa ICT.
answer_d: Tegeka, wamu n'omusomesa w'ebyemizannyo, olutindo lw'emizannyo olulimu ebintu ebiyingiriza omuntu nga mulimu n'obubonero bw'oku nguudo obuteekwa okutegeerekeka obulungi okumaliriza olutindo.

question:
Soma embeera eno wammanga:
Camila ali mu kibiina kya 5 era afuna obuyambi okuva mu kitongole ekigatta abaliko obulemu, olw’obwetaavu bw’enjawulo mu by’enjigiriza obuva ku ndwadde y’obulemu bw’obwongo. Mu kiseera kino, Camila asoma ebiwandiiko ebiwanvu wakati, wabula, alina obuzibu ku mutindo gw’okutegeera, naddala mu kuggyamu ekirowoozo ekikulu. Mu somo ly’Olulimi n’Okumatiza, omusomesa akolera ku kiruubirirwa: "okusoma n’okutegeera ebiwandiiko ebitali bya bulombolombo ku bubwo", mu ngeri eno, amawulire. Nga twekenneereza ekiruubirirwa ekigambiddwa, ku bikolwa bino wammanga kiki ekisinga okuba ekituufu mu kukulakulanya obukugu mu kukola ku mawulire mu Camila?
answer_a: Soma amawulire ate era okole omufumbiro nga olowooza ku bintu ebikulu ebyabaddewo n'abantu abasinga okuba abakulu mu byo ebiwandiikiddwa.
answer_b: Soma amawulire ng'okozesa omulingo gwa "okusiiga langi okukuumuusa", ng'osiiga langi ku birowoozo ebikulu n'ebintu ebyaliwo ebikwatiddwa mu buwandiike.
answer_c: Soma amawulire nga okozesa "ebibuuzo ebikulu" ebiyamba okukungaanya data, okutegeera ekyetaaga okukolebwako, enkolagana n'ebyo ebyayitamu, n'ebirala.
answer_d: Soma amawulire era okole akata ky'endowooza okuva ku mikwano egiteereddwawo wakati w'endowooza ezisinga obukulu n'ebikulu ebyogerwako mu kiwandiiko.

question: Soma embeera eno: Daniel mwana waakuna ng’alina obulemu bw’obwongo. Mu bintu by’asinga okumanyako mulimu obukugu bwe mu mbeera z’abantu n’engeri gy’ayogera, ng’anoonya era ng’asanyukira emikisa okukolagana n’abantu be be myaka emu n’abakulu, ne bwe kiba ng’asisinkanye abantu b’atamanyi. Mu somo ly’Ebyafaayo, Jjogolaafi, n’Ebyobufuzi, Daniel abaddeko obuzibu okutegeera emirimu n’obuvunaanyizibwa bw’abakulembeze abamu mu nteekateeka y’ebyobufuzi n’eddembe ly’obuntu mu Chile. Nga twetegereza engeri y’obulamu bw’omuntu n’obutonde bw’ensi, ku mirimu gino wammanga, gwe gusinga okusaana okukwasiza Daniel okutuukiriza ebyetaago bye?
answer_a: Kola vidiyo ng’eraga abantu abakulu ab’enjawulo abali mu bukulembeze bw’ebyobufuzi n’enteekateeka ya demokulasiya mu Chile, ng’omuntu yenna omukulu mu byobufuzi annyonnyola obuvunaanyizibwa bwe obukulu bw’alina okutuukiriza.
answer_b: Kozesa ng’obuyambi akatabo akakolebwa awamu wakati w’omukugu mu byafaayo n’omukugu mu by’enjigiriza ey’enjawulo, nga kalimu ebyafaayo ebikulu ebikwata ku bakulu ab’amaanyi mu nteekateeka y’essomero lye omuli ebibuuzo ebikwata ku bitundu ebikulu eby’emirimu gyabwe.
answer_c: Tegeka omukolo ogw’okwanjula abantu ab’obuyinza abali mu mbeera ye, ng’eky’okulabirako omukulu w’essomero, pulezidenti w’akakiiko k’abayizi, omuwanika w’ekibiina, n’abalala, nga kisinziira ku kubuuza okukolebwa okumanya emirimu gyabwe n’obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe.
answer_d: Londa olukalala lw'abakulembeze ab'ebyobufuzi abakulu mu ggwanga era ogende mu kisenge ky'ekkompyuta eky'essomero okunoonya amawulire agakwata ku mirimu gyabwe n'obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe, mu nkola y'ebyobufuzi n'entegeka ya demokulasiya eya Chile, era okuva ku ekyo, teekateeka olulimi olw'okwanjula nga weesigama ku kapaata.

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Marcelo, omuyizi ow'omwaka ogw'omusanvu, alina obulemu bw'obwongo, bw'afuna obuyambi okuva mu pulogulaamu y'ekibiina ky'amasomero. Mu myaka egiyise, akoze emikwano n'abayizi banne ab'omu kibiina, ekimuweeredde obuvumu obwetaagisa okwetaba mu kwolesebwa mu maaso g'abayizi banne. Wabula, mu mbeera mw'asisinkana abantu abatannamanya, ayinza okulabika ng'omukwafu era nga yeewala. Ng'ekimu ku kujaguza olunaku lw'Ebitabo, omusomesa we yategeka omuzannyo ogw'okukoppa ebyo ebiri mu kitabo ku somo ly'Olulimi mu maaso gwa kibiina ky'amasomero amalala. Okusobola okukola omulimu guno, yalonda ekitabo 'Omulangira Omutono,' kubanga kye kimu ku bitabo Marcelo n'abayizi banne bye basinga okwagala. Nga twekenneereza ku ngeri za Marcelo n'omulimu omusomesa gwe yategeka, mu nkyukakyuka zino wammanga, emitindo gy'okwanguya n'enteekateeka ennyangu gye gikozesebwa obulungi?
answer_a: Omusomesa ateekateeka omulimu ng’alowooza ku ngeri bbiri ez’okwetabamu: amaloboozi agookebwa (aga pre-record) n’emizannyo egikolebwawo mu butuufu, era n’asaba abayizi okutegeka n’okwewandiisa ku lumu ku mirimu ebiri.
answer_b: Omusomesa akubagazza Marcelo omulimu omulala era amusaba okuteekateeka olwoleso olumpi ku kitabo 'Omulangira Omutono,' lw'asobola okwanjula mu kibiina, mu maaso g'abayizi banne.
answer_c: Omusomesa w'olulimi awa Marcelo omulimu gw'okuteekateeka n'okukola, awamu ne mikwano gye, ebintu ebiraga ebifo eby'enjawulo ebigenda okukozesebwa mu mizannyo, bwatyo n'akwasaganya ebyo omuyizi by'ayagala n'obukugu bwe.
answer_d: Omusomesa alonda omuyambi okuva mu bayizi banne, nga kiba kirungi abeere mukwano gwe ennyo, okumuwa obuwagizi n’okumuwerekera mu bikolwa ebituusibwa mu maaso g’amasomo amalala, kubanga mu ngeri eno, omuyizi ajja kuwulira nga mutuukirivu.

question: Omusomesa omukugu ow'omwana Soledad, omuyizi ow'omwaka ogw'okubiri ng'alina obulemu mu kusoma, bw'aba awa lipoota y'enkulaakulana eri famire, agamba omukuumi bino: Mu maanyi ge twalabye mu Soledad mu ssemesta esooka, okussaayo omwoyo mu bikolwa eby'okusoma, okwagala ebintu ebirabika, n'okufuba okuyiga okusoma byeyoleka. Kyokka, akyalina okusoomoozebwa mu bikolwa mw'alina okutegeera ebigambo eby'ennimi ebikola ekigambo ekiri mu sentensi. Era alina okusoomoozebwa mu kutegeera ebigambo ebitandika oba okukomekkereza n'eddoboozi lye limu, okutuuma ebintu ebitandika n'ennukuta entondeke egendererwa, n'okwekenneenya n'okugatta ekigambo ekirimu ennukuta entondeke ennyonnyole. Nkola ki ey'obwongo omusomesa omukugu gy'ayogera ku bwetaavu bw'obuyambi bwa Soledad?
answer_a: Okuteeka ebirowoozo ku bintu eby'enjawulo mu buseera obutali bumalako.
answer_b: Okutondeesa obusobozi bw’okwawula ebintu ebiyita mu maaso
answer_c: Okutegeera engeri ebigambo gye bivuga
answer_d: Obukugu mu kusoma ebigambo

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Mu mulimu ogw'omukago ogw'ekibiina ky'abayizi mu kibiina eky'okubiri, kikakasiddwa nti okuyiga okusoma n'okuwandiika kujja kukolebwako nga bakozesa engeri z'okusomesa ez'enjawulo okuddamu okusoomoozebwa abayizi be balaze mu nkola y'okuvumbula amakulu g'ebigambo. Okutuukiriza kino, bakkiriziganya nti omusomesa omukugu mu by'enjigiriza enjawulo agenda kunoonya enkola ezisinziira ku nkola ey'okwekenneenya. Okusinziira ku mbeera eyo waggulu, mu nkola zino wammanga ze musomesa omukugu mu by'enjigiriza enjawulo z'ayinza okukozesa okukabiliza okusoomoozebwa kw'abayizi?
answer_a: Tambula okumanya, okutegeera n'okutuuma amannya g'ennukuta mu mutendera, okutandika n'ennukuta enjatuza nga tonnadda ku nnukuta nkalu
answer_b: Yiga amaloboozi g'ennukuta n'ebigambululo, ng'ogaziya ku nkola y'amaloboozi agava mu kugatta ennukuta.
answer_c: Tegeera era olukululate ebigambo, oluvannyuma obimenyemenye, okusooka mu bigambo byabyo ebitundu, olwokubiri mu bitundu ebizibu, ate oluvannyuma mu nnukuta zaabyo.
answer_d: Kozesa nsalessale ng’ebitundu ebikulu eby’okwogera n’okutegeera, okutandika n’ensalessale ennyonnyofu n’okwongera obuzibu okutuuka ku nsalessale enzibu.

question: Alicia, omuyizi ow’omu mwaka ogwokusatu, afunye okusoomoozebwa mu nkola y’okuyiga okusoma n’okuwandiika. Okuddamu eri kino, omusomesa w’abayizi abalina obwetaavu obw’enjawulo alowoozezza okuyigiriza buli nnukuta kinnoomu, okudda ku bigambo, sentensi, n’emikutu gy’ebiwandiiko; n’olwekyo, y’enkola y’okuyiga mpolampola eva mu kumanya obulungi enkola okutuuka ku kutegeera omutubi gw’ekiwandiiko, ng’essira liteekwa ku bitundu by’omubiri ebikozesebwa mu kuwandiika. Nga t базируемся ku mbeera eyo waggulu, ndagiriro ki ey’okusoma n’okuwandiika endagiriro omusomesa w’abayizi abalina obwetaavu obw’enjawulo gy’agoberera?
answer_a: Omulengo ogutunuulira ebintu byonna awamu
answer_b: Omugerageranyo omugatte
answer_c: Omulingo gw'ebinyonyogero by'ebigambo
answer_d: Omutindo gw'obukugu

question: Mu kibiina ky'ekibiri, ekibiina ky'abayizi kyakola omulimu omuli okubala ebintu mu namba okuva ku 0 okutuuka ku 50. Omusomesa awa Alberto obubala 20, era omuyizi bw'amala okubala, amubuuza, "Obubala bwonna bwemeka?" Omulenzi addamu, "Bubala 20." Oluvannyuma amusaba okuwandiika namba 20 mu katabo ke; wabula, Alberto awandiika namba 10. Okukakasa, omusomesa amuwa kaadi eriko namba 35, wamu n'obubala bwe bumu. Alberto asobola okubibala, naye ekizibu kye kimu kye kirabika; mu kifo ky'okuwandiika 35, awandiika 20. Okusinziira ku mbeera eyo, engeri ki esinga okuba entuufu okukola ku kizibu omuyizi ono ky'alina?
answer_a: Kukozesa emizannyo gy'obwongo okukulaakulanya engeri z'okulongoosaamu endowooza ennamu mu kubala n'okugonjoola ebizibu.
answer_b: Kozesa ebintu ebikwatika okukulaakulanya engeri z'okubala n'okukakasa ebyavaamu ku mutendera ogw'akamwa n'okuwandiika.
answer_c: Kozesa ebikokoto by'okubala okumuyigiriza ku birowoozo ebikulu ebikozesebwa mu kubala n'okubalirira.
answer_d: Mukozese omukutu gw'ennamba omutambulize okusobola okumuyamba okutegeera obulungi engeri ennamba eza desimoolo gye zikolamu n'engeri gye ziwandiikibwamu.

question: Ekibiina ky’ekibiina ky’abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw’okuna kiteekeddwa okuteekateeka omulimu mu somo ly’Ekibalangulo ogukolera ku Kiruubirirwa ky’Okuyiga: "Okupima obuwanvu n’ebipimo ebitongole n’okukyusa wakati w’ebipimo bino." Nga tulowooza, ku ludda olumu, obutaba na muganyulo eri okuyiga abayizi bwe balaze era, ku ludda olulala, obwangu ekibiina bwe kirina okukolera awamu, ekibiina kisalawo okukola omulimu gw’ekibinja ebweru w’ekibiina omuli abayizi abalina okulonda ebintu eby’enjuyi ennyingi ebiri wonna wonna mu ssomero, okubipima, n’okuwandiika obuwanvu bwabyo oluvannyuma okwekenneenya amawulire n’okukyusa wakati w’ebipimo. Okusinziira ku ebyo waggulu, ku ndagaano zino wammanga y’eraga ensonga lwaki enkola ekolezeddwa ekibiina ky’abayizi?
answer_a: Enyweza okuyiga okwesigamiziddwa ku muyizi okuyita mu mbeera z'okusomesa ezikwatagana n'embeera eziriwo.
answer_b: Kisobozesa okwetaba kw'abayizi mu mulimu, okuyita mu njawulo y'embeera z'okuyiga
answer_c: Kinyonyoza enkulaakulana y'olulimi n'obubonero obukwatagana ne jjomettiriya okuyita mu mirimu gy'ekibinja n'egikolebwa mu mbeera ezitaliimu buzibu.
answer_d: Okukulaakulanya okwefuga kw’empisa z’abayizi nga tuyita mu njawulo mu mbeera z’okuyiga.

question: Soma embeera eno: Ttiimu y’ekibiina ky’abaana abali mu mwaka ogusooka mu Ssomero lya Ssekendule ejja kukolera wamu n’abayizi ku mutwe gw’ekikula ky’omuntu mu mizannyo, mwe banaakulakulanya engeri y’okutegekera omuzannyo ku siteegi. Mu kiseera ky’okuteekateeka okusomesa, omusomesa omukugu mu by’enjigiriza ebyenjawulo alowooza ku mbeera za Cristina ne Carlos, abayizi abazuuliddwa nga balina obuzibu mu kusoma, obuzibu mu kwogera n’endowooza embi ku bikolebwa mu bibinja. Okusinziira ku ebyo waggulu, endagiriro ki ey’enjawulo esinga okuba ey’omugaso okukubiriza okuyiga n’okwetaba kw’abayizi bombi?
answer_a: Laga abayizi vidiyo z’okwegezaamu emizannyo gy’edrama, teekateeka ebigendererwa ebikulu ebiri mu vidiyo eby’enjawulo ebikwata ku kikula mu mizannyo gya drama era obakkirize okukola omulimu guno kinnoomu.
answer_b: Saba abayizi okukwata enkulaakulana yaabwe nga tebannatandika na bwe bamaze, nga bayita mu bifaananyi oba obubaanja, okubazzaamu amaanyi olw'enkyukakyuka n'okulongoosa kwe batuuseeko, era obayigirize engeri ez'enjawulo ez'okwogera.
answer_c: Mwekeneenye n'abayizi vidiyo ezikubiriza ezikwata ku kukolera awamu, muwe emitendera n'engeri ez'enjawulo ez'okwetaba mu kuzannya katemba era muteekateeke ensobi eziyinza okubaawo mu kwogera kwabwe.
answer_d: Teesa abayizi engeri y’okwekebejjaamu, kola ebibinja eby’okukolagana nga birina ebiruubirirwa n’obuvunaanyizibwa obutegeerekeka obulungi mu kuteekateeka omuzannyo, era mwegeereze ebiwandiiko nga mukozesa engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okuzannya nga temutegekeddwamu.

question: Ekibiina ky’abaana abato abategerekeka mu ssomero ly’abamuumu kyakola okukulaakulanya emirimu egy’enjawulo egy’olulimi. question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Pablo muyizi wa mwaka gwakubiri mu ssomero ly'abayizi abalina obulemu, afuna obuyambi olw'obwetaavu bw'ebyenjigiriza obw'enjawulo obuva ku ndwadde y'obulemu bw'obwongo bw'alina. question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kibiina ky'ekibalangulo, omusomesa w'ekibiina eky'okusatu akola ku kumalawo ebizibu ng'akozesa okukubisa, ng'akozesa ebigambo n'ebifaananyi okwongera okutegeera abayizi be. Omu ku bayizi bano ye Constanza, omuyizi alina obulemu bw'obwongo ayanguwa okukola omulimu oguweereddwa, n'addamu mu ngeri etali ntuufu. Omusomesa asalawo okuyamba Constanza mu ngeri eno: Okusooka, abikka ku mirimu n'olupapula okussa ebirowoozo bye ku bigambo. Amubuuza ebibuuzo Constanza asobole okukung'aanya amawulire ag'etaagisa okutegeera ekyo ekibuuza. Oluvannyuma amugamba okunnyonnyola ekizibu kye kirimu era amuwa omukisa okukiikirira amawulire agakung'aanyiziddwa mu bifaananyi. Oluvannyuma, abikkula ku mirimu era amugamba okuddamu, ng'atereeza embiro ze ez'amaanyi. Nga tutunuulidde embeera eyo waggulu, kulonda ki ku bigambo ebiwa obutuufu ku ngeri omusomesa gy'alonze okukozesa?
answer_a: Okukkiriza Constanza okukozesa engeri ez’obuyambi okusobola okutegeera omulimu, kiyambako okukendeeza ku bweraliikirivu obuyinza okubaawo ku mulimu ogwo.
answer_b: Okukubiriza okuyiga omukutu ogusobola okukulaakulanyizibwa mu biseera ebirala, okwongereza ku kuweebwa engeri entuukirivu egenda okuziyiza empisa ey’okukola ebintu nga tosoose kulowoozaako.
answer_c: Okukendeeza ku muwendo gw'ebigambo ebikulu ebikutegeeza n'okussa essira ku kutegeera omulimu ogukusabwa, ekiwa obwesigwa n'obumanfuufu ng'ogukola.
answer_d: Okukendeeza ku bikolwa eby’omukakanyavu, okukubiriza okukungaanya obutonde bwonna obwetaagisa okwongera okutegeera, okuleetawo enkizo y’obuyambi bw’amaaso, okwewala okuddamu okukola ensobi ate n’otereeza.

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Ttiimu y’ekibiina eky’okubiri eteekateeka enteekateeka y’omulimu gwa Sofia, omuyizi alina obulemu bw’obwongo era nga tamanyi kukwata bintu bingi (ebiwulirwa oba ebirabwa). Omuyizi yeetaaga okweyongera okukulaakulana mu kusoma, kale bakkaanya okwongera okukozesa obukodyo obuyamba okukwata ebintu mu ngeri ey’enjawulo mu mirimu. Okusinziira ku mbeera eyo waggulu, ku mirimu gino wammanga gwe mulimu ogusaana okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyateekebwawo ttiimu y’ekibiina?
answer_a: Zannya omuzannyo omuyizi mw'alina okumaliriza obutundutundu bw'amasannyalaze. Bw'akola ensobi, alina okudda ku ntandikwa.
answer_b: Zannya omuzannyo omuyizi mw’alina okuddamu ebiseera omusomesa by’amugamba: nga bwe kiri mu kyokulabirako era nga abizza emabega.
answer_c: Kuba akalulu k'ebigambo: Omuyizi alondoola ku kaadi ye akatundu omusomesa ke y'ayogedde era n'akiwandiika ku kaadi ye.
answer_d: Zannya omuzannyo omuyizi gy’alina okukyusa kaadi eziba zikudde waggulu n’akola ebiri ebiri nga asinziira ku ndobozi ennyonnyofu ey’ebigambo.

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Nahuel mwana muyizi wa kibiina kya bubiri ng’ayagala nnyo ebikolwa ebimusaba okukozesa ebintu n’okutambulatambula, kubanga ayagala nnyo okutambula mu ssomero buli kiseera. Ekifo ky’alina obuzibu obusinga kye kimu n’ebigambo bye bitono, n’okutuuka n’okuyita ebintu ebya bulijjo amannya nga ebikozesebwa mu ssomero. Olw’omuwendo omutono ogw’ebigambo by’amanyi, yeetaaga obuyambi okusobola okwawula ekibinja ky’ebintu okusinziira ku musingi ogumu ogwateereddwaawo. Okusinziira ku ebyo waggulu, endagiriro ki ku zino wammanga esobola okuyamba omwana ono okukulaakulanya obusobozi bw’okwawula ebintu?
answer_a: Kola emirimu gy'okwawulaawula egy'enjawulo, ng'okozesa ebiri mu masomo gonna omuli ebintu ebisobola okuteekebwa mu bibinja. Musabe okwatuukiriza buli kintu n'omusaba ekibinja ekikulu ng'obuuza: Bino byonna awamu bituyitira bitya?
answer_b: Kozesa ebintu eby’enjawulo ebiri mu kibiina bulijjo, gamba nga okutegeka, omuyizi gy’alina okwawula ebintu, ng’omubuuza erinnya lya buli kimu okusinziira ku mugaso gwakyo, oluvannyuma n’abiteeka ku mashelufu oba we bitera okubeera.
answer_c: Muwandiikire omwana omulimu ogw’amaanyi mu ssomero ogumusobozesa okwetaba mu bikolwa ebirimu okukozesa ebintu, gamba nga, okugaba ebikozesebwa. Mu kiseera ekyo, saba omuyizi okuyamba, ng’omusaba okwogera ebintu by’agaba n’omugaso gwabyo.
answer_d: Kozesa kaadi eziriko ebintu eby’abulijjo eby’enjawulo era osabe omuyizi okubiyita amannya okukakasa obumanyi bwe ku bintu ebyo n’ebigambo ebikozesebwa okubiyita. Oluvannyuma, musabe okwetoloolera oba okukolola ebintu byonna okusinziira ku mutindo ogwateekeddwaawo.

question: Soma embeera eno: Sergio ali mu kibiina ekisooka ku ssomero eririna obuyambi obw’enjawulo ku byetaago by’abayizi. Mu kiseera ky’ekibiina, asobola okukwatagana n’abayizi banne n’abantu abakulu abamukulu, era mu biseera by’okukwatagana, yeegatta ku mizannyo gy’ekibinja. Kyokka, mu kiseera ky’oluwummula, Sergio akendeeza ku kukwatagana kwe n’abayizi banne, ayoleka okwagala okuzannya yekka, tamalako matu, abuuka ku ntebe, alinnya ebintu eby’enjawulo mu mbeera, era yeetoloolera buli kiseera n’omubiri gwe. Mu buzibu buno wammanga obw’okukola ku birowoozo, buluwa obunnyonnyola embeera ya Sergio?

answer_b: Okusukkulumya ku busannyalaze obuva mu bitundu by'omubiri ebikozesa omubiri okutereera.

answer_d: Okusukkulumya ku bwangu bw’ebintu ebitwetoolodde nga tukozesa obwongo bwaffe.

question: Soma embeera eno: Martina mwana muwere ow’emyaka ena ng’asoma mu kibiina ekisooka ekya ‘transition’. Yatandika okwogera ebigambo bye ebisooka nga aweza emyaka ebiri n’ekitundu, nga bisinga kwetaagisa okumalawo obwetaavu obwangu. Mu kiseera kino, akyalina olulimi olutategeerekeka bulungi, oluusi olulimu ebigambo ebitali bitegeerekeka, newankubadde ng’enjogera ye nnungi bw’ayogera ebigambo by’awulidde ku ttivvi. Era azzaamu okwogera ebigambo ebimu okuva mu katuni ze yagala, ng’akoppa engeri y’okwogera erimu okukozesa obunyigirizi n’amaloboozi ag’enjawulo. Enjogera ya Martina esikirizza omusomesa we, ayagala okumukebera okumanya ensibuko y’enjogera eno, kubanga alina obweraliikirivu nti omwana ayinza okuba ng’alina ekizibu ky’obwongo ekya ‘autism spectrum disorder’. Kiki omusomesa ky’asaanidde okukola okusobola okukebera Martina?
answer_a: Kola olukalala lw’enneeyisa n’obukugu nga kigendererwa okuzuula engeri Martina gy’ayigamu n’obusobozi bwe, oluvannyuma okukola amateeka n’enkola z’emirimu.
answer_b: Teekawo omukutu ogulina entikko z’okukubisaamu amannya omuli amaka mwe bitundu by’enkulakulana eby’enjawulo mwe bikubirwa amannya, era okwanjula ebivaamu mu kukubisaamu amannya kuno n’ebyo ebiri mu kibiina.
answer_c: Saba okukebera amagezi ga Martina okuva mu famire okusobola okumanya obubonero bw'amagezi ge (IQ), era nga basinziira ku bigivudde mu kukebera okwo, kola enteekateeka y'emirimu egiraga ebiceera by'akulakulana byeetaaga okutumbulwa.
answer_d: Tegeka akakungunta akakebera ebirubirirwa ebitali bimu ebiteereddwawo mu Lukalala lw'Enkola y'Eby'enjigiriza y'Abaana Abato okusobola okutegeera ebitundu ebyetaaga obuyambi n'okulambulula ebyo ebituukiriddwa obulungi.

question: Okukeebera ebipimo eby'enjawulo eby'enkulaakulana y'omuyizi alina obulemu bwa Autism Spectrum ng'ayingira omwaka ogw'omunaana mu ssomero eririna ekitongole ky'abayizi abalina obwetaavu obw'enjawulo, bukubagizo ki obw'okukeebera obutuufu?
answer_a: Kola okunoonyereza okw’obwongo n’okusoma, wamu n’omukugu mu by’obwongo, ng’okozesa ekikozesebwa kya WAIS, okutegeera omutendera gw’obwongo omuyizi kw’ali.
answer_b: Teekateeka ebigezo ebikunukkiriza okumanya obusobozi bw'omuyizi nga weekenneenya embeera ze ng'omuntu era, weetaagisa, bikolere waggulu n'omusomesa omukugu mu by'enjigiriza eby'enjawulo.
answer_c: Kukung'aanya amawulire agakwata ku muntu, embeera ze mu bantu, n'obuwangwa bwe ng'okozesa akabinja akakugu mu by'okusoma n'obwongo, okutegeeza omutendera gw'enkolagana n'obwetongodde, okuteekateeka n'okukola enteekateeka y'ennyonyola y'eby'enjigiriza y'omuyizi.
answer_d: Teekateeka enkola y’okukebera okuzuula obuzibu, okusooka ng’ekubiriza okuyiga okutuusa lw’etuuka okugereka eby’omugaso, n’abasomesa b’ebuli somo, okutegeka enkyukakyuka zonna omuyizi z’ayagala.

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Mu kibiina ekisooka mu ssomero ly’abayizi abalina obulemu, mulimu Mateo, omuyizi alina ekizibu kya Autism Spectrum Disorder ng’alina embeera ennungi n’olulimi olukola obulungi n’ebiseera by’okuddamu ebigambo by’abalala. Obusobozi bwe obw’okusoma n’okuwandiika bumusobozesa okumanya ennukuta n’okwagala ebigambo ebikozesebwa mu nnukuta ezo, era asoma n’okutegeera ebigambo ebikwata ku mbeera ye ey’obulamu obwa bulijjo. Mu ngeri gy’ayogera, ayoleka okwagala ennyo ebintu ebimu era ng’alina obuzibu mu kukwataganya ebigambo n’ekikula kyabyo. Omusomesa wa Mateo alina ekigendererwa kino okuyigiriza abayizi bonna: Okutegeera ebiwandiiko, nga bakozesa amagezi ag’okutegeera by’osoma, gamba nga: okulaba mu bwongo ekyo ekiwandiiko kye kinyonnyola. Ku magezi gano wammanga, kiki ekikwatagana n’obwetaavu bwa Mateo?
answer_a: Kozesa ebigambo ebitegeerekeka gy'ali, by'akozesa ng'ayitira mu kumanya engeri ebigambo bwe bivuga, okukakasa omutendera gw'okusoma, okuwandiika, n'okutegeera.
answer_b: Kozesa ebiwandiiko ebiimpi era ebiwoomera, ebyogerwako mu kibiina, omuyizi alyoke afune omukisa okuwulira olulimi olutongole okusinziira ku kuba nti ebigambo bye bikulembera era ne bikozesa okutegeera.
answer_c: Kozesa ebiwandiiko ebisikiriza omwoyo nga birimu ebifaananyi omuyizi mw’asiigira ebikulu n’obuyambi bw’ebifaananyi, n’asuula ebitaliimu nsa okusobola okwongera okutegeera.
answer_d: Kozesa ebintu ebikwatika omuli ebigambo n'ebifaananyi, omuyizi alyoke akwataganye n'ekifaananyi oba endowooza bye bikiikirira, ng'agenda akola sentensi, okuva ku nnyangu okutuuka ku nzibu, ng'akozesa obubonero obuliiko ebigambo.

question: Soma embeera eno: Benjamin muyizi alina obulemu bwa Autism Spectrum Disorder nga asomera mu kibiina kya 2 mu ssomero eririna enkola ey’omutindo ogwa waggulu. Alina enkolagana ennungi ne bayizi banne era oluusi yeegatta ku mizannyo mu kiseera ky’okuwummula. Olulimi lwe olw’okwogera lukendeevu, ekireeta okutawaanyizibwa oba okubuzabuza mu kufuna n’okuwa amawulire, era tannatuuka ku kusoma kulungi. Mu somo ly’Ebyemikono, omusomesa omukugu ow’abayizi abaliko obulemu n’omukulu w’essomero bakolera ku kigendererwa kino: Okutegeka emirimu okukola ekintu eky’ebyemikono, nga bawula ebikolwa, ebintu ebikozesebwa, n’ebikozeso ebyetaagisa okutuuka ku ekyo ekisuubirwa. Mu bubinja obutono, abayizi bagenda kukola ebifaananyi by’ebintu, gamba nga leediyo, ttivvi, amasimu ageesigamiziddwa ku tekinologiya, n’ebirala. Ku lwa Benjamin, enkyukakyuka mu bigendererwa by’ebyokusoma egenda kukolebwa, nga kwe kukozesa ebifaananyi ebiraga ebyo bye twagala okukola okutegeka amawulire n’okwongerako emitendera egigobererwa okukola ekintu. Kiki ekigendererwa ky’enkyukakyuka mu bigendererwa by’ebyokusoma abakugu kye bagenda okukozesa ku lwa Benjamin okusobola okuyiga n’okwetaba nga banno?
answer_a: Okukolagana okw'obudde
answer_b: Okukyusa mu by'oyize
answer_c: Okugaggawaza omulamwa gw'ebyenjigiriza
answer_d: Okuteeka ebikulu mu biteeso by'okuyiga n'ebigendererwa byabyo mu maaso.

question: Soma embeera eno: Julian, omuyizi alina obulemu bwa Autism Spectrum Disorder, agenda mu ssomero ly'abaana abato eririna programu z'ebyenjigiriza eby'enjawulo. Mulimu, obusobozi bw'okwogera bulabika kubanga ayogera ebigambo ebimu eby'omugaso okutuukiriza ebyetaago bye ebya bulijjo. Ku bikwata ku bukugu bwe obw'okulowooza, ategeera ebimu ku bintu ebiri mu bintu ebiri mu mbeera, ng'akozesa mikono okulaga, era n'amannya ebintu ebimu ebya bulijjo ebikwata ku nkula n'ebiragala nga takozesezza nkola ya kigeraageranya. Omusomesa akolera, mu mutima gw'endowooza y'ekibalangulo, ku kiruubirirwa ky'okuyiga: Okukenenula enkolagana ez'omugaso mu kibalangulo, ng'atandikawo enkolagana okuyita mu mitindo n'ebintu eby'enjawulo. Nga tutunuulira enkulaakulana y'obukugu bwa Julian obw'okulowooza, mu nkola zino wammanga y'esinga okuba entuufu okukolerako ku kiruubirirwa ky'okuyiga omusomesa ky'ateese?
answer_a: Kozesa ebintu ebisuulibwa ebinaakozesebwa nga biteekeddwako obubonero obutegeerekeka eri Julian, mw’asobola okukolera dduyiro mu busobozi bw’ekibalangulo n’okutegeera, ng’ogoberera emitindo gy’enkula oba langi.
answer_b: Kozesa ebintu ebiri mu mbeera gy’alimu, by’asobola okukozesa okukulaakulanya obukugu mu kubala n’okutegeera ebintu mu ngeri entuufu nga abigabanya mu bibinja n’okubitegeka mu mutindo, okusooka ng’asinziira ku langi, ate oluvannyuma ng’asinziira ku kifaananyi.
answer_c: Kozesa ebintu n'obubonero ebiri mu mazingira, by'asaanidde okugattika, ng'alonda ebifaanagana ddala, okukakasa nti abitegeera ate oluvannyuma akole dduyiro ng'agoberera emitendera gy'enkula n'ebbala.
answer_d: Julian, kweyambisa obubonero obuli mu bifaananyi bino, nkukubiriza okukola dduyiro ezikwata ku bukugu mu kibalangulo n’okulambulula ebintu, ng’ogoberera emitindo gy’enkula n’obunene, oluvannyuma okolere ddala dduyiro ez’okuteekateeka ebintu mu ngeri entondeke.

question: Mu kibiina eky’okubiri omuli abaana abalina obwetaavu obw’enjawulo, Clara, omuyizi alina ekizibu kya Autism Spectrum Disorder, y’omu ku bayizi abagendayo. Alina obusobozi bw’okwogera, azzamu ebyo abantu abalala bye bamugamba, atandikawo emboozi, wadde ng’alina obuzibu okusigala ng’assaayo omwoyo ku mboozi etamunyumira. Kyokka, omusomesa bw’amuyambako okumunnyonnyola, asobola okuddamu okussaayo omwoyo ku mboozi eba etwaliddwa. Mu somo ly’Ebyettaka n’obutonde, omusomesa akola ku kigendererwa kino: “Okumanya n’okugeraageranya embeera y’amazzi esatu, enkalubo, ekulukusi, n’ey’omukka, ng’oyita mu kunoonyereza.” Mu ngeri zino wammanga, lwaki olwo lukozesa empandiika ya Clara mu kusomesa okw’enjawulo okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyo?
answer_a: Omusomesa agenda kulaga abaana bonna ebifaananyi n'ebigambo ebiri mu pulogulaamu ya kompyuta eya PowerPoint, byonna basome; agenda okunnyonnyola omutendera gw'amazzi n'obukulu bwagwo mu bulamu bwaffe; oluvannyuma, bagenda kukola omulimu ogubakulembera ku mbeera z'amazzi, era mu nkomerero, abaana bonna bagenda kugabana eby'okuddamu byabwe.
answer_b: Omusomesa agenda kusaba abayizi mu kibiina okuteekateeka ng'omuntu kinnoomu ennyanjula ku mutendera gw'amazzi, ezeeteekerateekerwa awaka; oluvannyuma lw'ennyanjula eyo, agenda kubagabira obupapula obw'okukolerako, bwe bagenda okuddamu ng'omuntu kinnoomu era oluvannyuma bagabane eby'okuddamu byabwe, nga bakebera obanga bituufu oba nedda.
answer_c: Omusomesa agenda kutandika essomo n'oluyimba 'Olugendo lw'Amazzi', oluvannyuma ayite abayizi okwetaba mu mulimu oguli mu kitabo ky'essomo 'Ebikolwa by'Omuntu n'Obutonde', ng'ateeka abayizi abalina obuzibu obw'amaanyi okumpi n'emmeeza ye, ng'agabanya obulagirizi era ng'akyusa ebirowoozo byabwe okwewala okutabuka.
answer_d: Omusomesa agenda kuyita abayizi okufuuka ‘Bannasayansi’, ng’akyusa ekisenge okukifuula labulatore mw’anaakolera okwegezaamu okukwata ku mutendera gw’amazzi; oluvannyuma, agenda kusaba abayizi okwegatta mu bubinja obutono bakole okwegezaamu kwabwe nga bakozesa ebintu bye baleese okuva awaka, ng’abalungamya okukwanaganya engeri gye bakolamu n’ebivaamu.

question: Cristobal, omwana ow’emyaka musanvu, yeenyigira mu ssomero ly’abaana abato era alina obulemu bwa myelomeningocele n’obulwadde bw’amaaso. Ttiimu y’omu classroom etera okukolera mu kifo ky’okuyiga okukolagana n’okutegeera obutonde bw’ensi, mu kunoonyereza okw’amaanyi ku butonde bw’ensi, ng’erina ekigendererwa kino: “Okutegeera ebintu ebimu ebikulu eby’obutonde bwabwe, gamba nga: ensolo.” Ttiimu erina okulonda ekintu ekyanguza Cristobal okwetaba mu mulimu ogukolebwa mu classroom. Mu bintu bino wammanga, kiki ekisinga okuba ekyetaagisa okusobozesa Cristobal okuddamu okusoomoozebwa kw’okuyiga okuteereddwawo?
answer_a: Akakondo akakozesebwa okukozesa ekkompyuta ekwata ku nsalu.
answer_b: Akakoomi k'oku kiboodi okulaga ebifaananyi ku kompyuta
answer_c: Okukozesa amaaso okulonda ebifaananyi ebiri ku kaadi y’ekkompyuta entono (tablet)
answer_d: Omutwe ogulaga ebifaananyi ebiragiddwa ku kiyungirizi ky'ebbalirizi

question: Mu wolokopa y’ekifo omutendekerwa abaliko obulemu obw’enjawulo mwe bakolera emigaati, abayizi beenyigira. Abetabye mu wolokopa basabye omusomesa okubawa omukisa okuyiga ku wolokopa endala ezikola omulimu gwe gumu, balyoke bagabane obumanyirivu, bawaanye ebirowoozo, era bongere ku nkulaakulana y’emirimu gyabwe. Nga tweyambisa embeera eyo waggulu, nkola ki omusomesa gy’asaanidde okukola okusobola okuyigiriza abayizi be?
answer_a: Tegeka okukyala mu bifo ebitundiramu emigaati ebiri kumpi.
answer_b: Ddukanya okutunda ebyamaguzi byabwe ku katale ak'omuliraano
answer_c: Nnonya emikisa gy’okulaga emirimu gye bakola mu wooshoopu.
answer_d: Kola enkolagana n’essomero lya sekendule eririna enteekateeka y’okufumba.

question: Omusomesa omukugu ow'abaana abalina obulemu mu ssomero ly'abaana abalina obulemu akola ku masomo g'Ebyafaayo, Ensi n'Obutonde, n'Ebyobufuzi, ng'alina ekigendererwa kino: "Okusoma n'okusiiga mapu enzibu ennyo ez'obutonde bwabwe, nga bakozesa ebintu ebiraga ekifo, ebika by'ebifo ebiriraanagana, n'obubonero obukubiddwa ebifaananyi." Abayizi be balina obulemu obw'enjawulo. Abamu boogera nga bayambibwa ebintu ebikwatika, abalala nga bayita mu bubonero obukiikirira ebintu okuva mu bulamu obwa bulijjo. Bangi ku bo balina obuzibu mu kutambula, obwetaavu mu nkola y'eby'omubiri, n'okusoomoozebwa mu mpisa. Okusinziira ku ebyo waggulu, ku mirimu gino wansi gy'erina okusobozesa abayizi okutuukiriza ekigendererwa omusomesa ky'ateekawo?
answer_a: Noonya ebintu ebikwatika mu kibiina nga okozesa maapu ennyangu era ng’ovvuunula akabonero akakozeseddwa.
answer_b: Okutegeera mapu eziraga ebifo ebikulu mu ssomero ezisobola okubayambako okukola emirimu oba okusaasaanya obubaka.
answer_c: Bakooneze maapu z'amaka gaabwe, nga boogera ku bye basangamu era nga bakozesa endowooza ezikwata ku kifo.
answer_d: Okuzannya okubasobozesa okumanya webasinzidde mu kifo ekimu mu ssomero, nga bakozesa omulamwa gw'okumanya ebifo.

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Camila muyizi alina obulemu bw’ennimi obw’okwogera era ng’ayingira mu kibiina ekisooka mu ssomero lye. Mu lusoma lwa pulayimale, yafuna obuyambi obwenjawulo okuva eri ttiimu y’omu kibiina, era yalaga okukulaakulana okwamaanyi. Wadde kiri kityo, ttiimu y’omu kibiina ekizuula nti omuyizi yeenyigira mu bikolwa naye azibuwalirwa okuddamu ebintu ebimusaba okwebazaamu, gamba nga bw’aba ayanjula, newankubadde ng’akozesa ebintu ebimuyamba. Ku bikwata ku bigezo ebitongole, wabaawo okusoomoozebwa mu kulaga obumanyi bwe, newankubadde ng’afuna obuyambi okuva eri omusomesa. Nga kitundu ku nkola y’okwebazaamu, ttiimu erina okupima okukulaakulana kw’omuyizi okukwata ku nteekateeka z’Enkola y’Obuyambi eri Omuntu Kinnoomu. Nga twekenneereza embeera ennyonnyoddwa, nkola ki ey’okwebazaamu esinga okuba entuufu okupima okukulaakulana kwa Camila?
answer_a: Kifuule ebyo omuyizi by'agenda okukeberwa nga byangu okuyita mu kukozesa ekigezo ekitongozeddwa.
answer_b: Tebukulembeza kukebera bukugu mu lulimi nga okola olukalala lw'okwetegereza.
answer_c: Kola ekiwandiiko ekinnyonnyofu okulaga ebintu omuyizi by'atuuseeko mu masomo ge.
answer_d: Kungaanya amawulire mu kitundu kyonna eky'okusomesa ng'okozesa ebikozesebwa eby'enjawulo ebipima.

question: Mu ssomero lya pulayimale esooka, mulimu abayizi abalina obulemu mu ngeri gye boogera, nga balaga obusobozi obulungi mu bigambo byabwe naye nga tebeenyigira nnyo mu kibiina. Omusomesa omukulu ateekateeka essomo erigenderera okumanya omuwendo gw'ebigambo ebiri mu sentensi, era asalawo nti abayizi balikyusa okuddamu ku lubaawo era buli omu alina okulonda sentensi okuva mu nnyingi ezireeteddwa. Nga twekenneereza embeera ennyonnyoddwa, nkola ki eyawuleyawule ekubiriza okwenyigira kw'abayizi?
answer_a: (Nzijukira, siyinza kukola ekyo. Ndi musomesa, so siri muyizzi wa bifaananyi.)
answer_b: Kusaba engeri ez'okuddamu ezitali za bigambo mu mirimu.
answer_c:
(Nga bwe kiragiddwa, siyinza kukozesa bifaananyi.)

1. Translate the following sentence into Luganda: "What is the main function of the mitochondria in a cell?"

Kiki omulimu omukulu ogwa mitochondria mu butoffaali?

Nnyonnyola omulingo gwa photosynthesis n'obukulu bwagwo eri enkola y'ebiramu.

4. Translate the following sentence into Luganda: "Describe the structure of a DNA molecule and its role in heredity."

Nnyonnyola endowooza y'amaanyi agasikayo ebintu n'engeri gye gakosa ebintu.
answer_d: Londa ebigambo ebikozesebwa abayizi bonna

question: Soma embeera eno: Francisco, omuyizi ow'omu mwaka ogw'omukaaga ng'alina obuzibu mu kubala (calculus), asangiddwa n'ekibuuzo kino kya math: Mu famire erimu omuli ab'oluganda basatu, Carlos ye muto, Pedro ye wakati, ate Jorge ye mukulu. Pedro alina emyaka ebiri egya Carlos, ate Jorge alina emyaka esatu egya Carlos. Ab'oluganda abo basatu balina myaka mingi ki? Kirage mu ngeri y'ekibalangulo (algebraically). Oluvannyuma lw'okwekenneenya ekibuuzo ekyo, omuyizi azzeemu bwati: "X + 2 + 3". Nga tutunuulidde ebyo waggulu, buzibu ki obw'okuyiga obulagiddwa Francisco?
answer_a: Okumanya obulungi engeri ezikozesebwa mu kubala aligebra.
answer_b: Okukiikirira embeera entuufu nga tukozesa olulimi lw'ekibalangulo
answer_c: Okutegeera okusoma okuli wansi w’okukola ebibazo by’aligebra
answer_d: Okusunsula ebimanyisiddwa ebikwatagana n'okugonjoola ebizibu by'ekibalangulo

question: Soma embeera eno: Ku ntandikwa y’omwaka, akabinja k’abayizi abali mu kibiina eky’okubiri bagenda kukola omulimu gw’okuzuula obumanyirivu bw’abayizi mu kusoma n’okuwandiika. Okukola kino, balowooza okukozesa ennyimba. Amawulire ge balina ku kibiina kwe kuba nti waliwo abayizi abazuuliddwa nga balina obulemu mu kusoma, abamu ku bo balaga nti tebamanyi kusoma wadde okuwandiika, n’abalala abalaga nti tebaagala kusoma. Okwongerezaako, okusinziira ku mawulire agaaweereddwa omusomesa omukugu mu by’enjigiriza ey’enjawulo, enkola y’obumanyirivu eyakozesebwa omwaka oguwedde teyaleeta nkulaakulana eyali esuubirwa. Nkola ki etuukirawo okukwataganya embeera y’okuyiga eno?
answer_a: Musome era muyimbe oluyimba wamu n'abayizi balyoke bawandiike ebitundu byabwe bye baagala ennyo nga bakozesa ennukuta ezisengekebwa.
answer_b: Kozesa ebibuuzo ebibakulembera abayizi basobole okusala n'okutegeka obutundutundu bw'amannya g'ennyimba ezitali zimu.
answer_c: Laga olunyiriri lw'oluyimba olusanyusa abayizi balukoppe mu biwandiiko byabwe, balambike ekitundu kye basinga okwagala mu lwo, era baluyimbe.
answer_d: Mulonde era musimbeko olukoloboze wamu n'abayizi, akasirikale akasembyayo mu mutwe gw'ennyimba ez'enjawulo basobole okwawula okufaanagana n'enjawulo wakati waazo.

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Ttiimu y’ekibiina ky’abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw’olubereberye mu somero ly’omutendera ogwa waggulu abasoma Olulimi n’Obuwangwa bateekateeka okukolera awamu n’abayizi okutegeera ekitundu ky’ekitabo, nga bakozesa amaanyi mangi okunyonyola engeri ekifo gye kikosa emboozi. Omusomesa omukugu mu bayizi abetaaga obuyambi obw’enjawulo alaga nti abayizi, nga mw’otwalidde n’abo abalina obulemu mu kusoma, balaga obwetaavu bw’obuyambi okusobola okutegeera omukwano oguli wakati w’ekifo n’ekikolwa, kale n’asaba okukola ebikolwa ebisooka ebyangu okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa. Okusinziira ku ebyo waggulu, nkola ki esaanidde okukozesebwa okuddamu eri embeera y’abayizi ey’okuyiga?
answer_a: Soma emboozi okuzuula omuzira omukulu, londawo ebanga n’embeera ebamwetoolodde, tegeera ebibaleetera okukola ekyo, era olonde ebipimo by’enneewulira zaabwe.
answer_b: Kola n’essuula y’ekitabo kye bagenda okusoma okutegeka ebikolwa by’abazannyi abakulu n’ebifaananyi era okutegeera ebibatuukako, ebifo we bibeera, n’abalumwa.
answer_c: Tegeka amakulu agali mu kigendererwa eky’okutuukibwako okusobola okutegeera ekifo eky’ebyogerero n’ebikolwa by’abantu abalimu, era okutegeera embeera, obudde, obuntu, ekifo ky’ebirowoozo, n’ebikolwa.
answer_d: Londaamu ebitundu okuva mu katabo akalimu ebifaananyi okusobola okuteebereza abantu abaliko kye bakola, we bali, era n’okutegeera engeri gye bawuliramu, ng’osinziira ku biwandiike ebiri n’ekifaananyi, endowooza z’abantu abaliko, n’ebintu ebirala ebiriwo.

question: Soma embeera eno: Leonor ali mu kibiina kyakusatu era alina obulemu mu kusoma. Okusobola okusoma nga bulijjo, omuyizi ono yeetaaga okwenyigira ennyo n’okufumiitiriza ku kuyiga okusoma n’okuwandiika. Okuva bwe kiri nti enkola ezisinziira ku mutindo gw’obumanyirivu tezinnavaamu bigendererwa, omusomesa omukugu mu by’enjigiriza entegeke ateekateeka enkola endala ezitunuulira engeri omuwala gy’ali. Ng’ekyokulabirako, obwetwaze bwe n’okwagala kwe okuyigira ku bikozesebwa ebirabika. Okusinziira ku ebyo waggulu, nkola ki etuukirawo okukozesa ne Leonor?
answer_a: Tegeera akatundu akasooka okuva mu lukalala lw'amannya okumukubiriza okuwandiika akatundu ako n'okukola ebigambo ebyesigamiziddwa ku kyo
answer_b: Laba katuni ez’enjawulo okumusindikiriza okulonda ekifananyi ky’asinga okwagala era okikubise mu buwandiisi mu ndabika n’enneeyisa.
answer_c: Kebera ebitabo ebikulu eby’enjawulo okumukubiriza okunoonyereza n’okuwandiika enfumo (infographic) ekwata ku mawulire agali mu byo, ng’otunuulira okuteekateeka, okuwandiika, okukolola, n’okusaasaanya ebiwandiiko.
answer_d: Soma ekigambo era olonde ennyingo ezitali nnume okumusindika okuzimba ebigambo eby’enjawulo nabyo, nga olowooza nti yeetaaga okutegeera eddoboozi lyabyo n’okubikwata mu mutwe ng’ayambibwa ebifaananyi.

question: Soma embeera eno: Ttiimu y’ekibiina ey’eby’emabega, eby’obutonde, n’ebyobufuzi ey’ekibiina eky’okuna etegekanya omukolo ogutandika okukola ku kiruubirirwa ky’okuyiga "okuzuula ebifo ku maapu nga tukozesa ennyingo z’ebifo (emisalaba n’emirongo)". Okukola kino, balina okutunuulira empisa z’ekibiina zino: - Abayizi 20. - Okubaawo abayizi abalina obulemu bwa ADHD n’obulemu bw’okuyiga. - Beetaba nnyo mu bikolwa ebirina omugaso. - Bafiirwa essira nga bakola ku biwandiiko n’ennyanjula ez’omumwa. Okusinziira ku mpisa z’ekibiina ezinyonnyoddwa, nkola ki etuufu okutandika okukola n’ekiruubirirwa ky’okuyiga ekiragiddwa?
answer_a: Kozesa ekitabo ekinene eky’ebifaananyi n’abayizi, gamba ng’ekifaananyi ky’ensi yonna, basobole okunoonya amawanga ag’enjawulo ku kyo, kibasobozese okumanya ebifo byago we biraga ku maapu.
answer_b: Zannya emizannyo gy'oku kaadi n'abayizi, gamba nga, olutalo lw'amaato, basobole okuzuula ebifananyi ku lukalala lw'ebifo, kibayambe okunoonyereza ku biri mu ssomo nga tebannalitegeera bulungi.
answer_c: Kozesa ebintu bya pulasitiika ng'omupiira, abayizi basobole okukuba olukoloboze olugalamivu n'olugolokofu okukirako, nga kibasobozesa okuzuula omugaso gwabyo ku ttaka ly'ensi.
answer_d: Zannya n'abayizi okuzuula amawanga, okugeza, ku guloobu, balyoke bamanye omukutu gw'ensi n'olunyiriri lwa Greenwich, kibayambe okutegeera endowooza zino ng'ebifo eby'okutandikirako.

question: Mu nkola zino wammanga, y’eri etuukana n’okukulaakulanya obusobozi bw’omuyizi ow’ekibiina ekisooka aliko obulemu, obw’okuteekateeka ebintu mu mbeera y’ekibiina?
answer_a: Saba omuyizi akole ebintu ebyo kwejjulula ebiraga engeri gy’ebikolwa bye bwe bikosa ebintu ebirala.
answer_b: Wa wano we wetaaga okuteekawo emirimu egikubiriza omuyizi okusalawo okuyita mu bibuuzo eby'ekiggwo ebitaliiko bukomo.
answer_c: Teekawo emirimu gy’okukakasa omuyizi mw’akakasa ekintu ekikoleddwa n’agenda mu maaso mu ngeri entengejje.
answer_d: Teekawo emirimu mu biseera ebyeyongera, omuyizi mw’alina okukoppa ebimuweereddwa okusobola okutuuka ku kiruubirirwa.

question: Soma embeera eno: Sofia alina emyaka ekkumi, ali mu kibiina kyakusatu, era alina obulemu mu kusoma. Mu kubala, akola ebikunizo ebiwandiike nga ayambibwa ebifaananyi era ategeera emisingi gy'ekibalangulo, ng'alaga obwetaavu bw'okuyambibwa mu kuwandiika akabonero k'ekibalangulo. Omusomesa we omukulu akolera mu kibiina ku bukugu bw'okugonjoola ebizibu by'okugatta n'okwawuza. Okusinziira ku bubaka buno, ku bikolwa by'obusomesa bino wammanga kiki ekikulaakulanya obukugu bw'okugonjoola ebizibu by'ekibalangulo?
answer_a: Muwabule abayizi okuteesa embeera mwe bayinza okutondekerawo ebizibu by'ekibalangulo.
answer_b: Kkaatiriza n'abayizi ebikolwa n'ebivaamu by'ebibuuzo by'ekibalangulo ebyakolebwa edda.
answer_c: Gaba mannyaazi mu bibinja by'abayizi bana bana, abasaanidde okukola ebyo byonna ebyetaagisa n'okuwandiika ebyavaamu ku lubaawo.
answer_d: Mukkirize engeri ez'enjawulo abayizi ze bayinza okukozesa okwogera ku ngeri gye bakozesezza okugonjoola ekibuuzo ky'ekibalangulo.

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Bwe yatuuka mu ssomero ly'abaana abato, Camila yazuulibwa ng'alina obulemu bw'obwongo, era abakulu mu kibiina basaanidde okukola Pulogulaamu y'Obuyigirize ey'Omuntu kinnoomu okukulaakulanya obukugu obw'okusoma oba obusookerwako mu nkola y'okusoma, okutwalira awamu okulaba n'okwawula ebintu, nga batunuulira ebyo omuyizi byayagalira. Nga basinziira ku nkola y'okusoma ey'ensi yonna, ku bikolwa bino wammanga kiki ekikulaakulanya obukugu bw'okusoma mu mutendera ogwasooka?
answer_a: Tondawo akatabo ko nga kalimu ebigambo ebikulu by'oyize.
answer_b: Gatta ebifaananyi by’abantu be ab’omumaka be abasinga okumpi, okuyita mu mizannyo gy’okujjukira n’eya lotto
answer_c: Kozesa kaadi eziriko ebifaananyi n'ebigambo okukwataganya ekifaananyi n'erinnya ly'omuntu wo ow'oluganda amukwatagana.
answer_d: Tegeera ebigambo eby’amaanyi mu nsi yonna, ng’okozesa amannya g’ab’oluganda lwe ab’oku lusegere ng’ebigambo by’oyiga.

question: Soma embeera eno: Roberto muyizi muzzibe atannabaakwatamu lukung'aana lw'okufumba. Okufumba kumusanyusizza nnyo, era ayagala okukolera mu kisaawe kino. Wabula, yeewulira nga talina bumalirivu ku busobozi bwe okukozesa ebikozesebwa ebiwawa, ekimuleetera okusoomoozebwa mu kuyiga kwe. Omusomesa omukugu ow'abayizi abalina obulemu mu lukung'aana ataddewo ekigendererwa kino: Okuyiga obukodyo obw'okukuuma obulamu nga batema era nga bakwata emmere okusobola okufumba ku bwabwe nga tebatuusa bulabe bwonna. Kino kimanyiddwa nti alina okukwatagana n'okuddamu ebyetaago bya Roberto eby'obuyambi. Okusinziira ku ebyo waggulu, nkola ki esinga okuba entuufu okukwatagana n'ekigendererwa ekyateesebwa?
answer_a: Kozesa omutendera gwa mukono ku mukono okusala enva endiirwa, ng'ogoberera ebiragiro ebiri mu kunoonyereza kw'omulimu.
answer_b: Kozesa ekikuumi ky'engalo, nga waliwo n'ebiragiro, wansi w'okwekenneenya omulimu okusala enva n'ebibala ku kaati akasalirwako.
answer_c: Goberera ebiragiro eby'omumwa okuva eri omusomesa okubala n'okutema enva endiirwa nga tokosezzaako kaadi yonna, okuyita mu kumanya enjawulo nga okukozesa obukakamu.
answer_d: Kozesa obutundutundu obutono obwa siliikooni oba ffoamu ya labba okukola akabonero we ekiso we kitandikira, oluvannyuma osale emmere ku kaatiingiboodi.

question: Soma embeera eno: Rodrigo, omuyizi omuzibe okuva bwe yazaalibwa, ng’alaba ebintu ebikwata oba ebinene ebiri okumpi naye, ayingira essomero ly’abaana abato eririna enteekateeka y’okugattika abalema n’abatali balema, era ng’afuna omukisa okusoma omulundi ogusooka. Abasomesa be bakizuula nti omuyizi alina okukulaakulana kw’amannya kw’ebintu okutali ku mutindo ogw’emyaka gye. Nga tweyambisa embeera eno n’obulwadde bwa Rodrigo, bubonero ki obw’okusomesa obusinga okumuyamba n’abayizi abalala bonna okutuuka ku mutindo ogw’okukulaakulana kw’amannya kw’ebintu ogw’ekibinja kyabwe?
answer_a: Abaana banyumya emboozi ez'enjawulo nga bakola mizannyo mu bibinja.
answer_b: Abaana bazannya okusobola okunnyonnyola n'okuzuula ebigambo ebipya okuva mu ngero.
answer_c: Abaana bakebera ebintu ebikwatika, obutindo, okubumba n'okuwa endowooza ku ngeri zaabyo.
answer_d: Abaana batambula okugenda mu bifo by'omukitundu, nga bakebera ebintu ebipya nga bakozesa okukwatako.

question: Soma embeera eno: Maria Luisa ali mu kibiina kya 4 mu ssomero eririna enteekateeka y'obuyigirize egattika abantu bonna. Alina obulemu ku maaso olw'okuzuulibwa ng'alina endwadde ya aniridia ne horizontal bilateral nystagmus. Mu kibiina ky'Ebyafaayo, Geography, n'Ebyobufuzi, akabinja k'abayigiriza kagenda kukolera ku kiruubirirwa kino: Geraageranya engeri ebintu ebirabika n'ebya butonde (nga ensozi, emigga, enkoola, amabeere g'ennyanja, obudde, n'ebirala) bwe biri mu bifo eby'enjawulo mu kitundu ky'ewaabwe. Okukola kino, akabinja k'abayigiriza keetaaga okuteekateeka enkola eneeyamba Maria Luisa okwenyigira. Nkola ki eyanguya okwenyigira kwa Maria Luisa n'okutuukiriza ekiruubirirwa?
answer_a: Laga, okuyita mu by'okumuwulira, ebika by'obuyitiro bw'ettaka eby'enjawulo.
answer_b: Teeka ebifaananyi ebiraga ebika by'enkula y'ettaka eby'enjawulo nga byeyambisiddwa ebintu ebikwatika
answer_c: Kola kaadi ezirambika ezannyonnyola buli kika kya ndabika y'ensi.
answer_d: Zimba omulengo ogulina obubonero obukwatika ogukozesa ebika by'enkula y'ettaka eby'enjawulo.

question: Soma embeera eno: Amalia mwana muwere ow’emyaka ena, alina ekizibu ky’obulemu bw’olulimi olw’okwogera, era asomera mu ssomero ly’abaana abato ery’olulimi. Omusomesa we alaga nti ayagala nnyo okwetaba mu kibiina; wabula, mu nkulaakulana y’olulimi lwe, kirabika nti tasobola kwetegereza byetaago by’oyo gw’ayogera naye era tassaamu kitiibwa ku nkyukakyuka mu kibuuzo n’okuddamu. Ate era, bw’ayogera, aleka ennukuta /r/ mu kigambo, tamenyerawo biti bya makulu era tannayogera sentensi eziragira n’ez’obukakafu. Nga tutunuulidde emyaka gya Amalia, mu mutendera gw’olulimi ki obuyambi bwe bweetaagisa mwe bulabikira?
answer_a: Amakulu g'ebigambo
answer_b: Eby'amaloboozi
answer_c: Ekikolwa ekigendereddwa
answer_d: Enkola y'ebigambo n'engeri gye bikolamu sentensi

question: Soma embeera eno: Gabriela mwana waakusatu mu ssomero eririna ekitongole ekikwasaganya abayizi abalina obulemu obw’enjawulo, era alina obuzibu mu bigambo by’akozesa. Abasomesa be bakizudde nti bw’aba mu bibinja ng’ayogera, by’ayogera tebikwatagana n’omutwe gw’ensonga era omuntu gw’ayogera naye bw’amusaba okwongera okunnyonnyola, alekera awo okwogera nga tamuddangamu. N’olwekyo, basabye abakugu mu by’obulemu okumukebera. Mu nkola zino ez’okukebera, y’ennu ebasobozesa okukung’aanya amawulire agakwata ku byetaago by’omuyizi ono?
answer_a: Teeka mu lukalala okutegeera olulimi olw'ekifaananyi mu mbeera z'abantu.
answer_b: Kozesa enkola ennyonnyofu ey'obukugu ekolebwamu mu kwogera.
answer_c: Kola olukalala lw'empisa ezeeyolekedde mu kwegattako ng'okozesa ekipimo ky'okusiima.
answer_d: Ekoloboza erinnyonnyola enkozesa y'emboozi ezirimu sentensi enzibuwavu mu lulimi olw'obuntu.

question: Mu mbeera y’okukyala mu myuziyamu, ku mirimu egiddwa wammanga, gwe guwa abayizi abalina obulemu bw’ennimi obw’enjawulo omukisa okukulaakulanya omulimu gw’olulimi ogw’obuntu?

answer_c: Teesa omuzannyo 'olugendo olw'ekirowoozo' abayizi mwe bayingirira omuwandiiko mu ndowooza oluvannyuma ne bannyonnyola olugendo lwabwe.
answer_d: Teekawo ebifo eby’emboozi omuli abayizi mwe basobola okubuuliza omukulembeze w’ettendekero ly’ebyamazina ebibuuzo nga: Ani omukugu eyakozesezza ebintu bino? Nkola ki gye yakozesezza mu mulimu gwe?

question: Ku ndagaano zino wammanga, engeri ki eraga endowooza y’olulimi okusinziira ku tteeka lya Chomsky?

answer_b: Olulimi lusetendeka lw'ebintu n'amateeka agategeddwa agava mu nkola ezaazaalibwa nazo.
